    # Find the comment textbox; use a more specific selector if possible

    # I'll use a more robust approach: wait for the textbox to be visible
    await comment_textbox.wait_for(state='visible')
    
    # Fill the comment textbox with 'Good idea'
    await comment_textbox.fill('Good idea')
    
    # Find and click the submit button for the comment
    # Use exact=True to avoid ambiguity as per previous error
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Comment', exact=True)
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the comment to be posted and page to update
